title: Attachment.
officialText:
Fasteners for wood shingles shall be corrosion resistant with a minimum penetration of ¾ inch (19.1
mm) into the sheathing. For sheathing less than ½ inch (12.7 mm) in thickness, the fasteners shall extend through the sheathing.
Each shingle shall be attached with a minimum of two fasteners.
